top.title: Dubai introduces digital Nol QR tickets for metro, buses and trams
top.teaser: Public transport passengers in Dubai can now use digital QR codes on their phones to access the metro, trams and buses, eliminating the need for a single-use red paper Nol ticket. Passengers can buy digital Nol QR tickets through the Nol Pay or S'hail apps, the Roads and Transport Authority announced. top.title: Dubai tenants, landlords settle rental disputes in six days on average

The Rental Disputes Center said it concluded 2,350 amicable settlement cases between January and the end of September, involving a combined value of Dh401 million.
